page_title: NME Drug and New Biologic Approvals in 1999 (archived FDA year table, Updated through December 31, 1999) cross-checked line-by-line against CDER Novel Drug Approvals Compilation (media/177921, approval-year 1999 section)
columns: NDA Number | Proprietary Name | Established Name | Applicant | Review Classification | Approval Date | Indication
classification_legend: P = Priority Review; S = Standard Review; O = Orphan Designation (Sec. 526 Orphan Drug Act)
row_count_note: DISCREPANCY DOCUMENTED 2026-09-12: the archived 1999 CDER year table lists 35 NDA rows and has NO BLA section (in 1999 therapeutic biologics were CBER-licensed pre-BPCI Act). FDA's current official Novel Drug Approvals Compilation (media/177921) lists 37 approval-year-1999 rows: the 35 common rows match the year table date-for-date, PLUS Ontak (BLA103767, 2/5/1999) and Wellferon (BLA103760, 3/25/1999), which FDA's current compilation includes via NDA-to-BLA transition. All 37 included here (Compilation = current official enumeration; the 2 extras flagged). Old-table N0-prefixed numbers map to Compilation numbers with leading zeros dropped (N021042->21042). Quirks kept verbatim: year table prints 'Ferrlicit' in the indication for Ferrlecit; year table prints 'UCB Pharm' while Compilation prints 'UCP Pharma' (same UCB group); INOmax indication contains FDA typos ('indicated an an conjunction', 'evidence or pulmonary hypertension'); Ellence/Synercid carry PLR N05 numbers (N050778/N050747+50748).

rows.indication: Pletal is indicated for the treatment of intermittent claudication.
Panretin is indicated for the treatment of cutaneous lesions in patients with AIDS-related Kaposi's sarcoma.
Treatment of patients with persistent or recurrent cutaneous T-cell lymphoma whose malignant cells express the CD25 component of the IL-2 receptor.
rows.compilation: Seragen; BLA103767; receipt 1997-12-09; Priority. Compilation-only row (not on archived 1999 year table): CBER-licensed at approval; NDA-to-BLA transition. Seragen was acquired by Ligand Pharmaceuticals (LGND) in 1998 - decision-date owner Ligand.

rows.indication: Ferrlicit [FDA prints 'Ferrlicit' (sic) for Ferrlecit] is indicated for the treatment of iron deficiency anemia in patients undergoing chronic hemodialysis who are receiving supplemental erythropoietin therapy.
rows.compilation: Makoff R&D Labs; NDA20955; receipt 1997-12-30; Priority

rows.indication: Treatment of chronic hepatitis C in patients 18 years of age or older without decompensated liver disease.
rows.compilation: Glaxo Wellcome; BLA103760; receipt 1997-09-30; Standard. Compilation-only row (not on archived 1999 year table): CBER-licensed at approval; NDA-to-BLA transition.

rows.indication: Agenerase is a protease inhibitor that is indicated, in combination with other antiretroviral agents, for the treatment of HIV-1 infection.

Xenical is indicated for obesity management including weight loss and weight maintenance when used in conjunction with a reduced-calorie diet. Xenical is also indicated to reduce the risk for weight re-gain after prior loss.
Vioxx is indicated for the relief of the signs and symptoms of osteoarthritis, for the management of acute pain and for the treatment of primary dysmenorrhea.
rows.compilation: Merck Research Laboratories; NDA21042 + NDA21052; receipt 1998-11-23; Priority. IRREGULARITY: Vioxx withdrawn from market 9/30/2004 (cardiovascular safety).

rows.indication: Avandia is indicated for the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus as monotherapy or in combination with metformin.
rows.compilation: SKB Pharms; NDA21071; receipt 1998-11-25; Priority. IRREGULARITY: rosiglitazone restricted 2010 (cardiovascular safety); US discontinued 2015.

rows.indication: Hectorol is indicated for the reduction of elevated iPTH levels in the management of secondary hyperparathyroidism in patients undergoing chronic renal dialysis.
Zaditor is indicated for the prevention of itching of the eye due to allergic conjunctivitis.

Actos is indicated for the improvement of glycemic control in patients with type 2 diabetes as monotherapy, or in combination with a sulfonylurea, metformin or insulin when diet and the single agent does not result in adequate glycemic control.
Relenza is indicated for the treatment of uncomplicated acute illness due to influenza virus in adults and adolescents twelve years and older who have been symptomatic for no more than two days.
Antagon is indicated for the inhibition of premature LH surges in women undergoing controlled ovarian hyperstimulation.
Technetium Tc-99m Depreotide is indicated for patients presenting with pulmonary lesions on computed tomography and/or chest x-ray who have known malignancy or who are highly suspect for malignancy.
rows.compilation: Diatide; NDA21012; receipt 1998-06-16; Priority. Diatide (NASDAQ:DITI) acquired by Nycomed Amersham 1999 -> GE Healthcare 2004.

rows.indication: Temodar is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with refractory anaplastic astrocytoma, i.e., patients at first relapse who have experienced disease progression on a drug regimen containing a nitrosourea and procarbazine.
Sonata is indicated for the short-term treatment of insomnia.
Raplon is indicated for outpatients and inpatients as an adjunct to general anesthesia to facilitate tracheal intubation, and to provide skeletal muscle relaxation during surgical procedures.
rows.compilation: NDA20984; receipt 1998-06-25; Standard. IRREGULARITY: Raplon voluntarily withdrawn 2001 (bronchospasm risk).

rows.indication: Aciphex is indicated for 1) healing of erosive or ulcerative gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD); 2) maintenance of healing of erosive or ulcerative GERD; 3) healing of duodenal ulcer; 4) treatment of pathological hypersecretory conditions, including Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome.
Ellence is indicated as a component of adjuvant therapy in patients with evidence of axillary node tumor involvement following resection of primary breast cancer.
rows.compilation: Pharmacia and Upjohn; NDA50778 (PLR number); receipt 1998-12-15; Priority

rows.indication: Rapamune is indicated for prophylaxis of organ rejection in patients receiving renal transplants.
rows.compilation: Wyeth Ayerst Research; NDA21083; receipt 1998-12-15; Priority

rows.indication: Synercid is indicated for the treatment of patients with serious or life-threatening infections associated with vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium (VREF) bacteremia.
rows.compilation: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer; NDA50747 + 50748 (PLR numbers); receipt 1997-09-05; Priority (indication [A] VREF; [B] skin infections)

rows.indication: Alamast is indicated for the prevention of itching of the eye due to allergic conjunctivitis.
Tikosyn is indicated for the conversion of atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter to normal sinus rhythm.

Comtan is indicated as an adjunct to levodopa/carbidopa to treat patients with idiopathic Parkinson's Disease who experience the signs and symptoms of end-of-dose "wearing-off" (so called "fluctuating" patients).
Aromasin is indicated for the treatment of advanced breast cancer in postmenopausal women whose disease has progressed following tamoxifen therapy.
rows.compilation: Pharmacia and Upjohn; NDA20753; receipt 1998-12-21; Standard

rows.indication: Tamiflu is indicated as a treatment of influenza A and B.
Curosurf is indicated for the treatment (rescue) of Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) in premature infants.
rows.compilation: Dey Laboratories; BLA20744 (transition product: NDA pre-BPCI -> BLA); receipt 1996-07-03; Standard. Dey Labs private (Nattermann/Merck KGaA lineage).

rows.indication: Keppra is indicated as an adjunctive therapy in the treatment of partial onset seizures in adults with epilepsy.
rows.compilation: UCP Pharma [UCB group; year table prints 'UCB Pharm', Compilation prints 'UCP Pharma']; NDA21035; receipt 1999-02-01; Standard
rows.flag: FDA sources disagree on applicant spelling (UCB vs UCP); same UCB group (Belgium)

rows.indication: Levulan Kerastick plus blue light illumination using the BLU-U Blue Light Photodynamic Therapy Illuminator is indicated for the treatment of non-hyperkeratotic actinic keratoses of the face and scalp.

Optimark is indicated for the use with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in patients with an abnormal blood barrier or abnormal vascularity of the brain, spine and associated tissues; and with MRI to provide contrast enhancement and facilitate visualization of lesions with abnormal vascularity in the liver in patients who are highly suspect for liver structural abnormalities identified on computerized tomography.
Solage is indicated for the treatment of solar lentigines.
Avelox is indicated for the treatment of acute bacterial sinusitis, acute bacterial exacerbation of chronic bronchitis, community-acquired pneumonia.
Precedex is indicated for the sedation of initially intubated and mechanically ventilated adult patients in an ICU setting.

Tequin is indicated for the treatment of acute bacterial sinusitis, community-acquired pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbation of chronic bronchitis, urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, and uncomplicated gonorrhea.
rows.compilation: NDA21061 + 21062; receipt 1998-12-28; Standard. IRREGULARITY: Tequin withdrawn 2006 (dysglycemia).

rows.indication: INOmax is indicated an an conjunction with ventilatory support and other appropriate agents, is indicated for the treatment of term and near-term (>34 weeks) neonates with hypoxic respiratory failure associated with clinical or echocardiographic evidence or pulmonary hypertension, where it improves oxygenation and reduces the need for extracorporeal membrane oxygenation. [FDA prints 'indicated an an conjunction' and 'evidence or pulmonary hypertension' (typos), verbatim]
rows.compilation: Ino Therapeutics; NDA20845; receipt 1997-06-16; Priority. INO Therapeutics later Ikaria (private) -> Mallinckrodt 2017.

rows.indication: Targretin is indicated for the treatment of cutaneous manifestations of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma in patients who are refractory to at least one prior systemic therapy.
